fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-05-23, around 17:40, the complainant paid an advance of Rs. 25,000 for a tour package, but the service was not provided and the payee stopped responding, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-05-25. Rakesh Krishnan approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000381. The account reference SYN-ACC-100075 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. A person named Tamilarasan Muthu, associated with the number 9000000260, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes digital documents, physical documents and a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00056, as the mobile number 9000000260 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Digital document; Physical document; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Advance allegedly collected for a service that was not provided.
